name: multiply by transforming, multiplying pointwise, and transforming back
mechanism: view the digit sequences as polynomials, evaluate both at roots of unity by a fast transform, multiply pointwise, transform back, and propagate carries, so the convolution costs near-linear time

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Schönhage–Strassen algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Number theoretic algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Schönhage–Strassen algorithm': an asymptotically fast multiplication algorithm for large integers
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fürer's algorithm': an integer multiplication algorithm for very large numbers possessing a very low asymptotic complexity

requires: a ring with suitable roots of unity
fails_when: only pays for very large operands
